lines.text: While Ezekiel sat in his house with the elders of Judah, the Spirit carried him in visions to Jerusalem.
At the north gate of the inner court, Ezekiel saw the idol that provokes jealousy and the glory of God.
Ezekiel dug through a wall and saw engraved idols and creatures, with the prophets of Baal holding censers.

wrong_details.true: seventy elders of the house of Israel

lines.text: The elders said the LORD had forsaken the land, and at the north gate women sat weeping for Dagon.
About twenty-five men bowed to the sun, and God said He would respond with wrath and not listen.
